case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your proposals; we value our 12-year relationship and are willing to accommodate your request for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms. To demonstrate our commitment to our partnership, we propose a price of €51.60 for this package. 

For our family-run foundry, maintaining these long-standing bonds in our region means everything to us, and our team takes great pride in supporting your production with the finest casting work. Please note that our offer includes a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot stays valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation for many more years to come.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your revised proposal, though the adjustment was quite small. As a long-standing family foundry proud of our craft and our enduring regional ties, we value our long-standing relationship and trust this brings us closer to a fair agreement. 

To keep the momentum going, we are willing to make a further concession to €51.50 for the 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms. Specifically, our current Angebot stands at a price of €51.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful work together and hope this path allows us to reach a good conclusion for both our companies.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your revised proposal, which shows a step in the right direction. 

Our traditional family foundry has always taken great pride in supplying high-quality castings across our region. We value our 12-year relationship and hope this brings us closer to a final agreement. In response to your movement, we are prepared to lower our price to a price of €51.30 per unit for the a contract term of 24 months with Zahlungsziel 60 days net. This proposal is valid from 1 December 2026.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our long and trusted cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your revised proposal, which shows continued willingness to find common ground. We value our 12-year relationship and trust this brings us closer to a fair agreement. In response to your movement, we are prepared to lower our price to €51.10 per unit for the 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms.

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot includes a unit price of €51.10 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 60 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Our family foundry takes great pride in the quality we deliver to our partners in the region, and we hope we can continue our shared work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
